The '''Hawkbat Gang''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] group formed by [[Drako]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="AA" /> Drako was the leader of the Hawkbats until his untimely death.
